files.name: Procedural build script
files.description: Reconstructs the cat from original mathematical geometry.

journal.title: Reference inspected · Blender ready
journal.notes: Visually reviewed all four supplied views. Using original mesh, procedural markings and a strand groom. No downloaded model, texture, or animal asset is used.

journal.title: First sculpt and coat review
journal.notes: Recognizable coat layout and raised tail. Eyes protrude, ear folds are too arched, black fur is too gray, and leg transitions look segmented. These are correction priorities, not a finished likeness.
